verdict.rationale: Bugbot automatically reviews every PR update across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps, flagging bugs, security issues and quality problems inline. The docs pair it with Cloud Agents, which open PRs that Bugbot then reviews, so agent-authored code gets machine review at volume. Hands-on users report it finds genuine bugs reviewers miss, though one user turned off auto-reviews after fix/revert flip-flopping. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of handling for agent-authored PRs (e.g., detecting or gating AI-generated changes), evidence of throughput or scale limits, and consistent independent corroboration of review reliability.
